scientific_status: exploratory reused-test extension because the hypothesis was motivated by earlier diagnostics on this test split

rank_model.tie_handling: inclusive interval-censored Beta-Binomial likelihood using R_lower=#(member<y), R_upper=#(member<=y)
rank_model.parameterization: m=sigmoid(eta_bias), kappa=2*exp(eta_disp), alpha=m*kappa, beta=(1-m)*kappa; zero parameters are identity
rank_model.zone_spread_interaction: centered zone-specific slope on standardized log raw spread

validation.group: calendar day; all 10 zones and all three model-seed archives from a date stay in one fold
validation.pooled_fit: one fold calibrator is fitted to the aligned forecasts from all three seeds; each seed remains separately scored
validation.shared_selection: one variant configuration selected by the mean objective across three separately scored seeds
validation.tie_break: lowest objective, then lower strength, then stronger regularization

ablations.legacy_G0: previous hour-wise empirical PIT calibration, preserved exactly
ablations.C0: hour-wise empirical PIT, grouped CV and primary bounded tail

conditional_groups.fit_source: validation raw forecasts only, averaged across the three aligned seed forecasts
conditional_groups.threshold_application: frozen for test; calibrated forecasts never define their own groups

bootstrap.cluster: 50 unique test calendar dates; resample a date with all 10 zones
bootstrap.seed_aggregation: compute paired deltas per seed under identical resampled dates, then average seed deltas
bootstrap.wording: bootstrap support fraction, not posterior probability

copula_claim_limit: only the stable-tie-break temporal member-rank template within each zone-day is audited; no spatial-copula claim

success_gates.CRPS_vs_legacy: at least 2 percent improvement with 95 percent calendar-day cluster bootstrap CI excluding zero

limitations_declared_before_scoring: The existing test split is not confirmatory for RAHC because it helped motivate the hypothesis.
Validation was previously used for base-model early stopping, so OOF calibration scores are not a fully independent base-model generalization estimate.
Three model seeds share the same realized observations and are robustness replicates, not independent datasets.
The existing seven-case SUC protocol contains five unique dates and is descriptive only.
